fact: On 2 January 2024 ANRPTS began operating the Houwiyeti app, through which citizens request paper and digital civil status extracts (birth, marriage, divorce, death) and issue their digital identity from the same account.
title: برنامج "هويتي" يبدأ العمل ويؤمن جميع أنواع مستخرجات الحالة المدنية
